briefing.headline: Soft landing holds as moderating inflation and steady jobs keep growth on track.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 hovers near the Fed's target, freeing rate pressure.
Unemployment at 4.2 percent for Sep 2026 holds firm, sustaining household spending.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury lower, from 5.09 percent to 4.96 percent.
